label: sec:organic-taxonomy-intro
html: The standard organic classes are sorted so that the familiar taxonomy falls out of the Hopf-chain framework. Two parameters do the sorting: the bond-order pattern (k_1, \ldots, k_{N-1}), and whether the structure is open or closed. Saturation reads as linking-site occupancy. The hydrogen capacity follows directly: \mathrm{C}_N \mathrm{H}_{2N+2-2d} (open) versus \mathrm{C}_N \mathrm{H}_{2N-2d} (closed), read off from the total degree of unsaturation. Aromatic rings appear as the case where the secondary trefoils close.
